headline: Trex (TREX) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Guidance And Analyst Target Increases
summary: Trex Company now carries a revised fair value estimate of about $52.94, up from $48.50, as the latest model update filters through to price targets. Many analysts are lifting their targets after Trex Company issued updated guidance, preliminary Q2 figures and outlined changes to its distribution approach, although views on the stock remain split. As you read on, you will see how these shifting targets fit into the broader narrative and what to watch as the story continues to evolve. Stay...

headline: DaVita (DVA) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Analyst Target Increases
summary: DaVita’s modeled fair value has shifted from US$193.71 to US$208.57, signaling a fresh round of updated price targets that investors are watching closely. Recent analyst commentary has taken a mixed but generally constructive tone, with higher targets often linked to DaVita’s growth investments, technology efforts, and focus on patient outcomes.
